# UI_PRINCIPLES.md — NexCredit
## Generated by Scriptwall Compass on 2026-05-22

## Core Rules
- Mobile-first flow speed with no dead-end navigation.
- Every networked step must have deterministic loading, success, failure, and retry states.
- Success states are shown only after confirmed backend persistence for critical writes.
- Display backend-truth stage, not optimistic local-only state.
- Preserve current working structure and avoid out-of-scope redesign/refactor.

## Tone & Language
- Use simple, trustworthy, human-readable language.
- Inline errors must explain what failed and what user can do next.
- Fallback mode messaging must be truthful and non-deceptive.
- Compliance-related prompts should be clear, concise, and explicit.

## Interaction Patterns
- Checkpoint-based progression for new and returning borrowers.
- Resume-from-last-valid-step behavior after app restart.
- Retry-safe actions for unstable network conditions.
- Guarded transitions for mandatory verification steps.
- Admin-visible status transitions synchronized with borrower UI state.
